next.reason: 1985: 'identifier-2 [ ROUNDED ] … [ ON SIZE ERROR imperative-statement-1 ] [ NOT ON SIZE ERROR imperative-statement-2 ]'; 2023: 'identifier-2 [ rounded-phrase ] … choice indicators: zero or more of the alternatives, each at most once, in any order'. 2023 replaces ROUNDED with rounded-phrase, which adds MODE IS options.
